Pinned copy of the go2rtc 1.9.9 player (video-stream.js, video-rtc.js), unchanged, from the alexxit/go2rtc:1.9.9 image that Drishti
runs (go2rtc, MIT licence, https://github.com/AlexxIT/go2rtc). Loaded by components/live/player.ts with a subresource integrity hash
(lib/web/player-script.ts); tests/unit/player-script.test.ts pins both files. Replace both together when go2rtc is upgraded.
